description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Bulgaria Bulgaria 2026 nationwide rest-day facts with explicit Monday-Friday planning baseline result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when bulgaria 2026 nationwide statutory holidays, observed non-attendance days and January 2 one-off rest over an explicitly selected Monday-Friday planning baseline. November 1 is education-only and does not add general rest. No personal, shift, school, employer, bank/exchange, optional religious-leave, payroll or legal-deadline schedule is computed. Future years and additional local/sector closures are unsupported.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Saturday-Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2026 authority events. Requires explicit mon_fri_planning; education-only holidays do not create general rest.
Example user requests: Bulgaria: One-off euro transition rest, not statutory holiday. | Bulgaria: May 24 Sunday replacement. | Bulgaria: No nationwide school-holiday substitute.
Inputs: date (date); work_schedule (enum).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-01-02","work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"} | {"date":"2026-05-25","work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"} | {"date":"2026-11-02","work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources, work_schedule, is_statutory_holiday, is_observed_non_attendance_day, is_one_off_non_attendance_day, is_education_only_holiday, observed_for_dates, payroll_scope.
Formula: planning_workday = weekday AND no nationwide statutory/observed/one-off rest event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/bulgaria-public-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/bulgaria-public-working-day.md

work_schedule.description: Required explicit Monday-Friday planning baseline, not a universal legal roster.

name: check_bg_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Bulgaria 2026 nationwide rest-day facts with explicit Monday-Friday planning baseline

day_type.description: statutory_holiday, observed_non_attendance_day, one_off_non_attendance_day, weekend_baseline or regular_workday.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

is_education_only_holiday.description: November 1 education-only annotation; not extra general rest.

is_observed_non_attendance_day.description: Whether result.date is a pinned article 154(2) observed rest date.

is_one_off_non_attendance_day.description: Whether result.date is January 2, 2026 one-off non-attendance.

is_statutory_holiday.description: Whether result.date is one of the 14 general-scope article 154(1) dates; excludes education-only November 1 and non-attendance substitutes.

is_working_day.description: Working date in the explicit mon_fri_planning nationwide baseline, not an individual or school roster.

observed_for_dates.description: Original statutory holiday dates for observed non-attendance, or an empty list.

payroll_scope.description: Always not_computed; holiday and non-attendance pay rules differ.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Bulgaria Working Day
